messages:
meera patel: PTAL — removed unsafe dep 'fast-marshal' from runtime, bumped serialization shim, added fallback for old hosts. Updated CHANGELOG and smoke script.

sam chen: thanks — can you paste the smoke command you used? want to run in staging.

meera patel: ran locally + staging; smoke command:
```
./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --env=staging --jobs=4 --timeout=60
```
logs: staging link: https://staging.ci/redwood/testrun/4521

stella: quick question — any perf impact? microbench?

meera patel: ran a quick microbench, +0.2ms median token latency, p95 unchanged. pasted perf snippet:
```
median: 1.8ms -> 2.0ms
p95: 5.1ms -> 5.1ms
```

sam chen: sounds fine. Can you squash the fixup commit and force-push? also add a one-liner in changelog about fallback behavior.

meera patel: done — squashed and pushed (force). changelog entry added.

ci-bot: build https://ci.redwood/invocations/789 passed :white_check_mark:

stella: lgtm from me — @sam any objections to merge during today's merge window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam chen: nope, go for it after canary window. :+1:

meera patel: thanks all — merging after canary. PTAL if you want to verify canary logs.
